study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping the neuroanatomical heterogeneity of OCD using a framework integrating normative model and non-negative matrix factorization

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression normative model to predict voxel-wise GMV in HCs; applied to OCD patients to quantify deviations.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict voxel-wise GMV from age and sex in HCs and then applied the trained model to infer GMV of patients with OCD.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Voxel-wise gray matter volume (GMV) derived from T1-weighted MRI/VBM.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: subject-level morphological (gray matter volume, GMV) differences were derived using the normative model.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were predictors in the normative model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict voxel-wise GMV from age and sex in HCs
